versions.content: SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement is typed by an ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category STRING and no DataTypeMap exists If a SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement is typed by an Applica- tionPrimitiveDataType of category STRING and no DataTypeMap exists and the ApplicationPrimitiveDataType fulfills the following conditions: • ApplicationPrimitiveDataType . swDataDefProps . swRecordLay- out exists and values of SwRecordLayout . swRecordLayoutGroup . swRecordLayoutGroupFrom and SwRecordLayout . swRecordLayout- Group . swRecordLayoutGroupTo are both set to 1. • A ApplicationPrimitiveDataType . swDataDefProps . swTextProps exists and refers to an SwBaseType where the SwBaseType . baseTypeDef- inition . baseTypeEncoding is set to NONE and the value of SwBaseType . baseTypeDefinition . baseTypeSize is set to 8. then the SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement is a candidate for a primitive Data Mapping.
